## Summary

Describe the problem and the chosen solution.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Documentation or localization
- [ ] Database or migration change
- [ ] Security-sensitive change

## Validation

- [ ] Release build passes
- [ ] Automated tests pass
- [ ] Publish smoke check passes when applicable
- [ ] Manual Windows verification is described below
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests where practical
- [ ] Locale keys and placeholders remain synchronized
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, runtime `Data`, logs, backups, or `*.user` files are included
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when needed

## Manual verification

List the Windows version, steps, and results. Include screenshots or a recording for meaningful UI changes.

## Risk and compatibility

Describe database, settings, localization, privacy, security, performance, or upgrade impact. State whether rollback is safe.
